description: Fast static lint of a local project's source or build (read-only, no browser, no login): SDK loaded and called, loadingStop/gameplayStart/gameplayStop present, portal language used (locale/localeChange), no external ads/trackers/miners, no purchase UI, no own login, build security rules, sizes. Use it after gamealia_integrate_sdk and before the slower gamealia_run_autotest. Returns ok plus each check as pass/warn/fail with a message (how to fix it) and file:line.

backendHosts.description: Your own servers the game may call, as in the listing, e.g. ["mp.example.com", "*.example.com"]; other external hosts are flagged

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

name: gamealia_check_integration
title: Lint the SDK integration and policies
